args.body:
Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brings mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic city views and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and having your contact email up front is handy. Feedback: add more about you, such as projects, interests and a short bio, plus some visuals and a clear layout, so visitors have more to engage with.

Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. Your hobby of hiking comes across as personal and friendly. Feedback: add some posts with trail stories, photos, routes and tips, and a way to contact you or subscribe, to make it more engaging.
